entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker and temporal mage who leads the Coalition's small contingent at Urza's Tower and confides his guilt and his love for his daughter.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Dominaria's acclaimed archmage and a planeswalker; Teferi asks him to lead while Teferi is away on the time machine.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer and planeswalker who builds a replica of the sylex and the Temporal Anchor, and gives Teferi a clockwork peafowl.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker with a strategic mind and a network of informants who leads the war room and distrusts Tezzeret.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker, with a fire in her chest, whom Teferi recruited for her honest wisdom.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: A tree-like being who accompanies Wrenn.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who found Ajani alive and now mourns him; she warns the plan against New Phyrexia is a death sentence, then stays to defend the tower.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A hunter planeswalker who brings intelligence from Urabrask and heads to Ravnica and Ikoria.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker, revealed as a compleated sleeper agent.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem planeswalker taken by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Teferi's former mentor, a great artificer and planeswalker who built the tower and fought his brother Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, against whom Urza waged the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Subira
entities.description: Teferi's late wife, whose advice to look with his eyes he remembers.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's daughter, whom he is trying to save.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A Mirran leader who is alive and planning an assault on the Phyrexian core.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A planeswalker on Ravnica lobbying the guilds and the source of the news about Koth.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who has gone to Zendikar to contact Nissa.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker on Zendikar whom Chandra is going to contact.

entities.name: Urabrask
aliases: the praetor of the Quiet Furnace
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who opposes Elesh Norn and plans a revolution while communicating with the Mirrans.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A rival praetor who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to force her one singularity on the Multiverse.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who arranged Vivien's audience with Urabrask and still has access to the Planar Bridge; Kaya does not trust him.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: An angel leading Serran troops in Orvada.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer rallying dragons, viashino, goblins and Ghitu on Shiv.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Teferi's old headmaster at Tolarian Academy, whose wife Rayne died in a war Teferi spearheaded.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Barrin's dead wife.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Urza's well-preserved tower in a mist-shrouded Argivian vale, now the Coalition's base.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Teferi's homeland, which he spirited away from space and time.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane the Coalition defends.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian home plane that the Coalition plans to assault.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane where Kaya met a Phyrexian creature and whose World Tree might be repurposed.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Saheeli's time machine, made of swooping fiery orange metal and powered by the Weatherlight's powerstone.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: The ancient relic that was destroyed; Saheeli has made a perfect copper replica.

entities.name: World Tree of Kaldheim
entities.description: Kaldheim's tree that links the plane's realms, which Kaya fears the Phyrexians have repurposed.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance defending Dominaria against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders threatening Dominaria and the Multiverse.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers whose plan to counter Phyrexia is outlined.

events.summary: Teferi climbs the stairs of Urza's Tower, remembering his mentor and his late wife Subira.
events.quote: Teferi reached the top of the stairs, where he paused to catch his breath

events.summary: Jodah gives Teferi Kjeldoran biscuits made by Saheeli's construct, and Teferi asks him to lead while he is away on the time machine.
events.quote: I'd like you to consider being that person.

events.summary: Elspeth asks where Ajani is and Teferi tells her; she reacts with grief and silence.
Kaya briefs the group on the plan: the other planes are mobilizing and the Coalition will join Koth's Mirrans in assaulting the Phyrexian core.
events.quote: Without a head, the body will fail.

events.summary: Elspeth calls the plan a death sentence and storms out.
Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
events.quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

events.summary: Kaya suspects the Phyrexians have repurposed the World Tree of Kaldheim, which could join every plane.
events.quote: This is the World Tree of Kaldheim.

events.summary: Vivien names Tezzeret as the intermediary who arranged her audience, and Kaya objects strongly.
events.quote: You know what he did on Ravnica!

events.summary: Saheeli shows Teferi her perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Temporal Anchor.
events.quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex

events.summary: Saheeli gives Teferi a clockwork peafowl and says the Anchor will be ready that night.
events.quote: The Anchor will be ready to use tonight.

events.summary: Teferi confesses to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war and calls himself the true heir to Urza's mantle.
events.quote: Then I siphoned energy from the closed portal to fuel a spell spiriting Zhalfir away from space and time itself.

events.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi she is not here to absolve him.
events.quote: I am not here to provide you absolution, mage.

events.summary: Elspeth apologizes to Teferi, and he tells her about Ajani's compleation.
events.quote: I was there with him when it happened—when the compleation took hold.

events.summary: Teferi shares mitab fruit with Elspeth and tells her that everything he does is about saving his daughter Niambi.
events.quote: Everything I'm doing is about saving her .

events.summary: Elspeth offers to stay and defend them, and Teferi welcomes her.
Elspeth's sword glows and Teferi recalls his father's story of the wattle-eyes, choosing to believe.
events.quote: This time, Teferi chose to believe.

relations.quote: his former mentor strode through as a mortal man

relations.note: The brothers fought the Brothers' War.
relations.quote: to fight a bitter struggle against his brother, Mishra.

relations.note: Urza built the tower as his workshop.
relations.quote: Urza built this tower to be his personal workshop
How he wished Subira were there to cut through his tightly wound knot of concerns.
Urabrask and his forces stand opposed to Norn's aspirations.

relations.note: Urabrask is communicating with the Mirrans.
relations.quote: He's planning his own revolution and is communicating with the Mirrans.

relations.note: Tezzeret arranged Vivien's audience with Urabrask.
relations.quote: I'll vouch for him and for the intermediary who arranged for my audience with him.

relations.note: Saheeli made a replica of the sylex.
relations.quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex
The name was different this day—Ajani's instead of Rayne's.
He looked up to see Wrenn and Seven approaching.
